summary: A shopper grumbles at the new bag rule, then goes back to the car for bags.
realLife: On the first day of a state bag ban, one shopper had been reusing her plastic and paper bags and called the rule a nuisance, then saw another shopper with a bag, realized the rule had started and fetched her own. Another shopper forgot and took a free one while backing the ban. In a later state update, one man said he resented lawmakers telling him what to do and rigged his own cart bagging.
